pages.title: Sandevistan
pages.text: §lMax Level:§r III$(br2)§lApplies to:§r Chestplates (not elytra)$(br2)§lEffect:§r Press the activation key (default X, rebindable in Controls) to trigger bullet time: while active, the world around you is nearly frozen — mobs stop moving and drawing bows, projectiles (arrows/tridents) hang completely still, and other players are slowed as well (toggleable in the config), while you gain movement and attack speed boosts. Duration/cooldown: Tier I 5s / 10s, Tier II 15s / 30s, Tier III 30s / 65s; Bosses (Ender Dragon, Wither) are only slowed. A cooldown and a small hunger cost apply afterwards.$(br2)§lObtaining:§r Tier I: enchanting table, villagers, chests; Tiers II-III: structure chests only
